Hi Elena / SomaHealth AP team — thanks for the portal link and the clarification. Below are the concrete items we’ll upload and the instructions to ensure invoices match your ingestion rules. I’ve copied Finance (Marcus) for bank verification and Monica for the vendor KYC steps. Laura is your AM and will coordinate contract/PO metadata.

Redwood enrollment package (we will upload these to your portal and also send by email if you prefer):
- PDF: Redwood_Vendor_Profile.pdf — includes legal name, addresses for Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) and Redwood Inference Europe Ltd. (EU), and contact points.
- PDF: Redwood_EU_VAT_Statement.pdf — EU VAT ID: GB999999973 (example) for Redwood Inference Europe Ltd. (please validate this in the portal).
- PDF: Redwood_PO_Invoicing_Instructions.pdf — required invoice fields and example line-item formatting.
- PDF: Redwood_SEPA_Bank_Details.pdf — IBAN/BIC and remittance reference (SEPA is preferred for EUR payments).

Key invoicing rules for correct processing: 
1) Submit one PDF invoice per PO. If you need to submit multiple invoices against a single PO, include the PO number on each invoice and an explicit invoice sequence (e.g., Inv 1001 of 3).
2) Required invoice header fields: Supplier legal name, Supplier VAT ID, Invoice number, Invoice date, PO number (exact match), Invoice total, VAT amount (if applicable), currency.
3) File naming: SOMA_PO{PO#}_RDW_INV{invoice#}.pdf (e.g., SOMA_PO12345_RDW_INV1001.pdf). We can accept other conventions if you map them in the portal, but the above helps automated mapping.
4) Remittance: SEPA transfer to Redwood Inference Europe Ltd. — IBAN/beneficiary details are in the SEPA PDF. Reference the invoice number and PO in the transfer description so your remittance file matches.
5) VAT handling: If SomaHealth applies reverse-charge, include both parties’ VAT IDs on the invoice and a short reverse-charge statement: "Reverse charge (Art. 44–47 VAT Dir.) — customer liable for VAT." If VAT is chargeable, list VAT with the correct rate and our EU VAT ID.

Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date unless a different term is specified on the PO. Late fees are subject to the contract. Early payment discount requests should be routed through Laura so we can evaluate.

Next steps: 
- Marcus will confirm the exact SEPA beneficiary name and IBAN we will publish.
- We will upload the five PDFs to your portal by EOD tomorrow and notify Marco Bianchi.
- If you need a signed supplier agreement or W-8/W-9 equivalents, Monica will shepherd that paperwork.

Marcus: can you confirm the SEPA account name and last 4 of the IBAN for Elena to validate in the portal?

Elena: once uploaded, please confirm the vendor ID you assign so we can tie incoming POs to the correct ledger.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth onboarding.

Regards,
